# Changelog

## 1.0

- First release.
- Play Table with basic-strategy grading (S17 / H17), streaks and session stats.
- Count Trainer (60 stages) and Endless Count, Hi-Lo running count.
- Strategy Flashcards.
- Advantage calculator: house edge, player edge, $/hour, N0 and risk of ruin from
  measured table data.
- Strategy charts (hard / soft / pairs + Illustrious 18 deviations).
- Lifetime stats screen.
- QR code in Help linking to the companion app on Google Play.
